vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Hmm. That doesn't add up. Let me think it through out loud."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You give A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.

🌿 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~4 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (2 stone now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Marco about themself. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Wait — say that again? I want to check the logic."
🗣️ Chantal to a woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm, by the fire: "Stone. We need 58 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
🌱 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Rimay about A person, maybe 30s. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Interesting. But what's the underlying pattern?"
"Can we talk?" A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.

🔥 The fire settles. Shanice has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 40s, with restless hands says quietly "Say that again — slower." the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm, the postal worker asks "Say that again — slower." 📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

📚 Village knowledge: Yuki taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Yuki is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
💬 Benjamín has been asking you about Cold-Blooded — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
